data.gender_notes: Imranat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Imra' meaning 'grace' and the Persian word 'at' meaning 'beauty'. The name Imranat carries the meaning “Grace, Beauty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Imranat usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies the divine grace and beauty of God's creation.
data.etymology: Imranat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, Beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Imranat total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Imranat" holds a profound cultural significance for Muslims, as it is reminiscent of the great Islamic prophet Imam Imran. Imam Imran is known for his piety, devotion, and sacrifice, being the father of Prophet Hazrat Isa (Jesus) and Hazrat Mariam (Mary) in Islamic tradition. This name carries an inspiring reference to the noble character and legacy of this esteemed figure in Muslim history.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Imranat" holds a deep spiritual significance for those bearing it, as the name essentially means 'beauty through grace.' It serves as a constant reminder to embrace humility, kindness and grace in all aspects of life, ultimately working to uplift oneself and those around them. This name is a wish for the individual to cultivate inner beauty through acts of kindness, piety, and devotion to God.
